section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Acceptance by Others Scale (BAOS), a 10-item measure assessing perceived acceptance of one's body from friends, family, dating partners, society, and media. Participants rated items on a 5-point scale, with higher scores indicating greater perceived body acceptance. The text reports internal consistency (Cronbach's α = .90 for women, .92 for men) but does not provide sample characteristics, study design details, or correlational findings.
